meta.name: game-market-research
meta.description: Conduct market research for a game concept -- competitive landscape, market sizing, audience analysis, trend detection, and positioning strategy. Triggers on: "market research", "competitive analysis", "market sizing", "audience analysis", "is this game viable", "similar games", "market validation". Do NOT invoke for brainstorming ideas (use game-brainstorm) or economy monetization design (use game-economy-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析游戏概念的市场可行性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在评估一个游戏创意是否值得投入开发。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze market feasibility for a game concept
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are evaluating whether a game idea is worth developing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你做游戏概念的市场调研，包括分析竞品、估算市场规模、了解目标玩家、发现趋势，并给出市场定位建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“市场调研”、“竞品分析”、“这个游戏能火吗”等关键词，或要求评估游戏概念的市场可行性时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析一下这款类银河城游戏的市场前景。
say.note: Claude 会启动市场调研流程，从品类分析开始。

say.text: 我的游戏是种田模拟类，看看竞品有哪些。
say.note: Claude 会列出直接和间接竞品并分析。

say.text: 估算一下这款游戏在Steam上的潜在销量。
say.note: Claude 会进行市场容量估算。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will conduct market research for a game concept: competitive landscape, market sizing, audience analysis, trend detection, and positioning strategy.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "market research", "competitive analysis", "is this game viable", or ask to evaluate a game concept's market feasibility.

say_en.text: Analyze the market prospects for this Metroidvania game.
say_en.note: Claude will start the market research workflow from genre analysis.

say_en.text: My game is a farming sim. Check the competitors.
say_en.note: Claude will list direct and indirect competitors and analyze them.

say_en.text: Estimate potential sales for this game on Steam.
say_en.note: Claude will perform market sizing estimation.
